# Draft2Digital

> Draft2Digital is a self-publishing platform enabling indie authors to distribute ebooks and print-on-demand books globally across major retailers including Amazon, Apple Books, Barnes & Noble, and Kobo.

Draft2Digital provides comprehensive tools for independent authors to publish, distribute, and earn royalties from their work. The platform handles manuscript formatting, distribution to multiple retailers, and provides educational resources through live events and detailed guides.

## Key Topics

- Self-publishing
